topic: Analytics dashboard updates and release timing
summary_markdown: The analytics platform received general updates, including a responsive layout for all devices, cosmetic improvements, and bug fixes. Discussion centered on the new traffic calculation for the Mall Dashboard. The release timing of these changes is uncertain because the implementation details regarding dwell time are not fully confirmed. It was suggested that the question of releasing the feature should be raised during an upcoming meeting rather than immediately.
decisions: The release of the analytics updates, particularly those involving dwell time, will wait for a scheduled meeting.
action_items: Someone needs to follow up with Galina regarding the new traffic calculation for the Mall Dashboard.
